lines.lyric_translation: The curtain falls and I’m out of breath
I get mixed feelings as I breathe out
Did I make any mistakes today
How did the audience seem

lines.lyric: Geuraedo haengbokhae nan ireon naega dwaeseo
lines.lyric_hangul: 그래도 행복해 난 이런 내가 돼서
lines.lyric_translation: I’m happy with who I’ve become

lines.lyric: Nugungareul sori jireuge mandeul suga isseoseo
lines.lyric_hangul: 누군가 소리 지르게 만들 수가 있어서
lines.lyric_translation: That I can make someone scream with joy

lines.lyric: Chae gasiji anheun yeoundeureul pume ango
lines.lyric_hangul: 채 가시지 않은 여운들을 품에 안고
lines.lyric_translation: Still excited from the performance

lines.lyric: Ajikdo deoun teong bin mudaee seosseul ttae
lines.lyric_hangul: 아직도 더운 텅 빈 무대에 섰을 때
lines.lyric_translation: I stand on the middle of the empty stage, still hot

lines.lyric: Deoun teong bin mudaee seosseul ttae
lines.lyric_hangul: 더운 텅 빈 무대에 섰을 때 (ayy)
lines.lyric_translation: I stand on the middle of the hot, empty stage
And suddenly I feel so afraid of the void

lines.lyric: Bokjaphan gamjeong sogeseo salmui saseon wieseo
lines.lyric_hangul: 복잡한 감정 속에서, 삶의 사선 위에서
lines.lyric_translation: These mixed feelings with my life on the line

lines.lyric: Gwaensiri nan deo mudin cheogeul hae
lines.lyric_hangul: 괜시리 난 더 무딘 척을 해 (척을 해)
lines.lyric_translation: I pretend to be careless
This isn’t the first time, I better get used to it

lines.lyric_hangul: 숨기려 해도 그게 안 돼 (안 돼)
lines.lyric_translation: I try to hide it, but I can’t
When the heat of the show cools down
I leave the empty seats behind
Trying to comfort myself

lines.lyric_hangul: 완벽한 세상은 없다고 자신에게 말해 난
lines.lyric_translation: I tell myself the world can’t be perfect

lines.lyric_hangul: 점점 날 비워가네 언제까지 내 것일 순 없어 큰 박수갈채가
lines.lyric_translation: I start to let myself go / The thundering applause, I can’t own it forever

parts.lyric: Jeomjeom nal biwogane eonjekkaji nae geot il

lines.lyric_translation: I tell myself, so shameless
Raise your voice higher

lines.lyric_hangul: 영원한 관객은 없대도 난 노래할 거야
lines.lyric_translation: Even if the attention isn’t forever, / I’ll keep singing
I want to stay this way for life
I want to stay young forever
Aah Forever we are young
Under the flower petals raining down
I run, so lost in this maze
Forever we are young
Even when I fall and hurt myself
I keep running toward my dream
Forever ever ever ever / (dreams, hopes, forward, forward)
